crossRefs.note: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple, and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing…
As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.
but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for…
He asked his father, “How long has it been since this has come to him?” He said, “From childhood.
A woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her living on physicians and could not be healed by…
Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage…
A certain man who was lame from his mother’s womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple…
For the man on whom this miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old.
There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years, because he was paralyzed.
At Lystra a certain man sat, impotent in his feet, a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked.

translations.web: A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.
translations.bsb: One man there had been an invalid for thirty-eight years.
translations.kjv: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.
translations.asv: And a certain man was there, who had been thirty and eight years in his infirmity.
